description: Ministry of Labour and Labour Relations - Awards made to the Industrial Disputes between Mr. T. Raveendran and Sri Lanka Air Lines Ltd., and between the Ceylon Planters' Society and Chilaw Plantations Limited
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an industrial dispute arbitration award under the Industrial Disputes Act. It involves legal proceedings, court orders (Writ of Certiorari and Mandamus), judicial review by both the Court of Appeal and Supreme Court, and the application of labor laws and regulations. The content focuses on legal interpretation, statutory procedures under the Industrial Disputes Act, and the determination of compensation based on legal precedents and case law, making it clearly a Legal/Regulatory matter.
